data.body:
[P2] Validate original-request ordering across refreshes

Sorting each refresh does not preserve native invocation order when ledger publication is delayed. If a retry is collected first, it becomes the selected original; an earlier original discovered in a later refresh receives a retry ordinal. Both streams then satisfy the missing-stream check, while coordinator ownership checks trust the incorrect journal. This can validate a successful retry instead of the required original. Reconcile selection against service invocation chronology, or reject newly discovered evidence that precedes an already-bound original. Add a regression spanning two refreshes.
